subject: def
title: (R)DEF.------ AF.DY.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-40 (Social Reality / Trans-Information, Level Two), second of two on book p184, paired with v2-p184-1. Continues the definition argument: 'the significance of definition is directly related to the total concept of positive transformation. For the reality options of a given group are not separate from how that group perceives of itself.' (R)DEF (the reality of definition) is crossed with AF-DY (affinity dynamics): the question is what definition produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with affinity-dynamics — the (R) prefix marking that real definition (not imposed definition) is what links to real affinity-dynamics. PRIN-INFO (principle information) sits at the upper-center. AF-DY itself is the partner. PRIN-INFO and AFI (affinity insight) branch from the main line; POST (postulation) branches from AFI. PRIN-INFO carries SPI-GH (spiritual growth), which carries PART (participation); PART carries (R)ATTN (the reality of attraction), which carries PHY-U-C (physical universe context) and POL-DY (political dynamics); P-PROG (particular progressionalism) branches from POL-DY.
